info.name: EPG Licensing - Callback Case (PreProd2) - simple
info.description:
Two steps to create a Callback Case in PreProd2 through the standard Salesforce REST API.

1. **Get access token** - OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Fill `client_id` / `client_secret` in the collection variables. The token is stored in `access_token` automatically.
2. **Create Callback Case** - `POST /services/data/v59.0/sobjects/Case` with `RecordTypeId` = Callback (`012FW001nRU85B6YQJ` in PreProd2). Returns 201 with the new Case Id.

The token user must hold the `Callback_Case_API` permission set (assigned to ai.agent@epg.ae.preprod on 2026-09-18). A `NOT_FOUND` answer means the token user has no access to the Case object.

request.description:
Standard sObject create. `RecordTypeId` must be the Callback record type of the target org.

Optional extra fields: `AccountId` (001...), `ContactId` (003...), `Reason`, `EPG_Postal_Licence_No__c` (lookup to EPG_License__c).

Picklist values available on the Callback record type:
- Origin: Phone (default), Email, Web, Portal, Live Chat, Manual
- Priority: Medium (default), High, Low
- Type: Question, General, Licensing, Customer Complaint, Other, Renew Postal Activity License, No Objection Certificate
- Status is set by the support process (New on create).
